name: Gareth Llewellyn
bio:
Gareth's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly, inheriting his father's auto body shop in Cardiff. Initially focused on mundane repairs, he discovered a talent for custom paint jobs, particularly intricate designs and color matching. His reputation grew, eventually attracting the attention of a local rally team needing a specialist for their race cars. He joined Oregon Team five years ago, bringing a wealth of practical experience and a keen eye for detail.

Gareth's approach to his role is meticulous and pragmatic. He believes in using the best materials and proven techniques, always prioritizing durability and performance alongside aesthetics. He's not one for flashy innovations, preferring to refine and perfect existing methods. He takes pride in ensuring every car leaves the paint shop looking its best, ready to withstand the rigors of the track.

What sets Gareth apart is his ability to mentor younger members of the team. He patiently shares his knowledge and techniques, fostering a strong sense of craftsmanship and teamwork. His quiet loyalty and dedication make him a valued member of the Oregon Team.

physical.description: Gareth is a stocky man with a kind face etched with years of experience.

quirks: Always wears a spotless white overall, even when mixing paints.
Has a habit of humming Welsh folk songs while working.
Insists on using only natural bristle brushes for detail work.
